def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved empirical bivariate model for log10(|ID|/A) with interaction term."""
    a1, a2, a3, a4, b1, b2 = parameters
    interaction_term = a1 * (gate_voltage_abs - b1) * (drain_voltage_abs - b2)
    return a2 + a3 * gate_voltage_abs + a4 * drain_voltage_abs + interaction_term
